method: One offline encode_texts batch; existing SQLite image vectors only; 512-row score batches; no app/queue/search/rebuild/image encoding/cache writes.

prompts.original_names: 爱城华恋与神乐光站在东京塔上
prompts.empty_tower_control: 东京塔，没有人物的空景

limitations: Scores are raw cosine similarities, not identity, count, action or spatial-relation verification.
The empty-tower text is a diagnostic query, not a calibrated absence detector.
No rank weights or 75-percent threshold were fitted; unchanged production search scores are not recomputed.
Frame ranks deduplicate repeated source frames; window ranks take each window's best same-frame score.

sanitization.scope: Absolute local filesystem paths replaced with logical library/workspace paths; no media or model cache is bundled.
